rules.rule: When serving ROI mask slices, call `_loader_slice_index(affine, z, nz)` to map the slider index to the correct array index.

rules.rule: Any backend endpoint that extracts a 2D slice by z-index for overlay on a cornerstone-rendered image must call `_loader_slice_index` before indexing into the array.

rules.quote: Use `fontFamily: '"Courier New", Courier, monospace'` for any input or text that needs monospace styling.
rules.rule: For any input or text element that needs monospace styling, set fontFamily to '"Courier New", Courier, monospace'.

rules.quote: Any time `fontFamily: "monospace"` would be used in a `styles` or `style` prop on an input or text element, use the explicit Courier New stack instead.
rules.rule: Do not use fontFamily "monospace" in a styles or style prop on an input or text element; use the explicit Courier New stack ('"Courier New", Courier, monospace') instead.

rules.quote: Always derive the MRI window/level (VOI) from backend-computed intensity stats
rules.rule: Always derive the MRI window/level (VOI) from backend-computed intensity stats.
Do not derive the MRI window/level (VOI) from `image.minPixelValue`/`image.maxPixelValue` reported by `cornerstone-nifti-image-loader`.

rules.quote: `MriViewer.tsx` uses these to set `vp.voi`, with cornerstone's values as a fallback.
rules.rule: In `MriViewer.tsx`, set `vp.voi` from the backend `vmin`/`vmax` values, and use cornerstone's values only as a fallback.
